title: Protocol translation retirement playbook and client migration requirements
creator: Ana Patel
description: PRD and migration playbook for retiring the legacy binary streaming protocol (bs-proto) and associated v1 streaming endpoints. Goal: migrate clients to the Unified Multiplexed Inference API (UMI) and ensure no regressions in latency, error rate, or feature parity. This ticket covers requirements, phased timeline, acceptance criteria, translation/proxy shim plan, SDK guidance, comms plan, and post-retirement telemetry.
scope: Retire bs-proto /v1/stream endpoints across hosted and dedicated deployments
Provide a protocol-translation proxy (translation shim) for 6 months of overlap
Release client SDK helpers for automatic reconnect and migration guidance
Update Console routing, docs, and migration dashboard
Define observability and SLO guardrails during rollout
out_of_scope: On-prem air-gapped private deployments where customers opt out
Model architecture changes unrelated to protocol surface
Backwards-incompatible changes to UMI payload schema (handled in separate PRD)
migration_steps: Phase 0: Announce deprecation (T+0) with 12-month timeline, migration guide, and SDK changes
Phase 1: Release translation shim in hosted by runtime-1.22; enable by default for new customers, opt-in for others
Phase 2: Ship SDK helpers (JS/Python/Go) to detect bs-proto and auto-switch to UMI; add metrics and warnings
Phase 3: Run beta with selected customers for 8 weeks; collect errors, latency, and functional deltas
Phase 4: Enable telemetry gating and start progressive knob-down of shim for low-risk customers
Phase 5: Hard-disable bs-proto endpoints in hosted; publish final sunsetting date for Dedicated/Private with transport guide
acceptance_criteria: Migration guide published and linked from Console (docs.redwood.ai/bs-proto-migration)
Translation shim deployed in hosted and passing internal e2e test suite for 99.9% of common request shapes
JS/Python/Go SDK releases with automatic migration helpers (+ deprecation warnings) and integration tests
Telemetry dashboard shows <0.5% customer errors attributable to translation shim during beta
No increase in P95 token latency >10% for migrated traffic compared to baseline for UMI
Customer support runbook and FAQ published; at least two SEs trained and on-call for first 4 weeks
Legal/comms email templates and in-console banners scheduled for all affected customer tiers
observability_requirements: Expose a new metric umi_migration.status with values (natively_migrated, shim_translated, failed_translation, fallback_used)
Track per-customer error rate and P95 latency for shim vs native UMI
Create an alert if any customer sees failed_translation > 0.5% over 1h
Add migration cohort dashboard in Console and a public migration progress page
Log samples of failed translations (scrubbed) to S3 for debugging
rollback_plan: If shim causes regression (alerts triggered or customer-reported critical failures), revert to previous routing by flipping the feature-flag to route bs-proto directly to the legacy handler for affected customers, open an incident, and pause further knob-downs. Implement hotfix path for shim parsing errors within 1 business day for P0 issues.
risks_and_mitigation: Edge-case frames in bs-proto payloads causing translation mismatch -> mitigation: expand e2e fuzz tests and maintain a compatibility test corpus from production traces
Increased tail latency for shimmed requests -> mitigation: route high-QPS customers to native UMI after early analysis and provide dedicated capacity if needed
Customer-managed Private deployments lagging on migration -> mitigation: provide on-prem shim package and migration consultancy as a paid add-on
communication_plan: T+0: Public deprecation blog post and in-console banner (12 months notice)
T+30: Targeted emails to customers with active bs-proto traffic and recommended migration path
Weekly status updates to customers in beta cohorts
Final 30/14/7 day reminders before hard-disable with in-console CTA to open migration support ticket
Post-retirement: publish lessons learned and migration telemetry summary
sdk_changes_and_client_guidance: Release SDK 3.x with new 'autoMigrateBsProto' flag that enables detection and automatic translation
Add detailed examples for streaming-to-chat translation in JS and Python docs
Provide a lightweight proxy Docker image for customers that cannot upgrade SDKs immediately
Deprecation warnings surfaced at runtime with guidance URL and support contact
